jobs.title: Codex Task
jobs.summary: 1. **Partially; not Ready yet.** Duplicate local/self-notification invalidations only evict again, assuming synchronous generation-bump/discard. The real hole is commit-before-NOTIFY: current writes commit separately (`server/storage.ts:1922–1928,2025–2044`). A crash or notification failure afterward leaves healthy peers stale; their outage-only fallback need not activate. Couple notification transactionally to writes. After reconnect, commit LISTEN before flushing caches/in-flight work: missed notifications are not replayed ([PostgreSQL LISTEN](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/sql-listen.html)).
